prospective_scope: Additional event-to-neural time-base verification inside the same Allen audit, before visual-sync bit decoding. Original clock policy and M0 failures unchanged.
forbidden: No behavioral bits, analog photodiode values, running, pupil, spikes or scores
method: Pinned Allen stimulus_sync functions and documented EcephysSyncDataset.extract_frame_times_from_photodiode; cycle60,trim_discontiguous_frame_times=true,source-defined zero-frame correction. No parameter search or fallback configuration based on agreement.
scoring: Every saved start_time in both registered repeated stimulus tables, compared to nearest reconstructed physical stimulus frame timestamp; known global stimulus invalid intervals reported separately, no unregistered exclusions.
meaning: Timing-agreement diagnostic, not confirmation of exact physical timestamps, observation continuity, neuron firing adequacy or absolute calendar date
negative_result_policy: Preserve all failures/unmatched windows. No new cohort and no M1. Curated-only recommendation requires adequate explicitly supported mice; no retroactive original M0PASS.
